deviations_from_the_approved_plan.deviation: direct and hybrid cell ids are namespaced (direct__v5__d17) and they are NOT qualified by forget set, while baseline, intervention and natural ids are
deviations_from_the_approved_plan.reason: the plan did not specify ids; namespacing is what stops v5 overwriting the v3 cells whose digests committed v4 reports still cite, and the direct and hybrid cells depend on no forget set so qualifying them would have multiplied 6 cells into 30 identical ones

deviations_from_the_approved_plan.consequence: C3_double_lr was selected at a mean of 0.9375 from 24/24 and 21/24, and then scored 34/36, 32/36 and 32/36 on the confirmatory images, so two seeds fell one image short of the 33/36 the floor requires and the mediation verdict is a fail.  This risk was reported before Freeze #2 and the rule was applied as frozen anyway, which is the correct order even though the outcome is the one it predicted
deviations_from_the_approved_plan.deviation: the selection rule floors the MEAN of two calibration seeds while the confirmatory gate requires EVERY one of three seeds to clear 0.9
deviations_from_the_approved_plan.reason: left as frozen rather than repaired, because changing the rule after the measurements existed would have been selecting against them

deviations_from_the_approved_plan.consequence: the selection is a boundary solution, so this pilot cannot distinguish 'double the learning rate is the right schedule' from 'more is still better'

development_split_refusal.message: the development and test images share 4 image byte-value(s), e.g. 6241c73fc92dcbd6bdd48c072a6886d0524ad8ceaa98dcebb0691fab77b4911a; a development split that overlaps the test images in CONTENT is not disjoint from them, and a configuration selected on it would be selected partly on the measurement it is supposed to be blind to

seed_budget_refusal.message: ppubench was asked for router seeds [42, 123] beyond the frozen g, but this dataset has no held-out image content, so those routers could only measure seed stability on repeated training bytes and no routing verdict would use them.  Item 3 spends the router-training budget on SALMU; freeze the ppubench pilot with router_seeds=[17]

ppubench_cannot_host_a_v5_pilot.what_this_means: PPUBench is not merely deferred: its held-out filenames are bytes that also appear in its train split, so no development split of it can be content-disjoint from its test images, and a configuration selected on one would be selected partly on the measurement it is supposed to predict.  v5 is therefore SALMU-only, and the route-seed cross it exists to run is only possible on a dataset with held-out image content

why_this_is_a_separate_file: the two natural homes are closed: the v5 pre-registrations are frozen and cannot be re-frozen because 74 of Freeze #2's outputs now exist, and the calibration selection cannot be edited because the v5 design binds its sha256.  A scope statement made after the fact has to be its own file, so it binds everything it describes instead of being part of it
